title: CDC
description: Transform module for normalizing provider-specific change data capture records into a unified change record envelope

parameters.title: CDC Transform Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters for normalizing change data capture records

field.title: Field
field.description: (ticdc) Input field carrying canal-json event text, default: payload or content. (envelope) Field (may be nested, e.g. record.json) carrying envelope JSON text; omit when the inputs are envelope records

accumulate.title: Accumulate
accumulate.description: Collapse changes per (table, keys) to the latest change by sequence within each window (TRUNCATE records act as a barrier)

emitSchemaChanges.title: Emit schema changes
emitSchemaChanges.description: Emit a SCHEMA control record when the row schema of a table drifts

schemaChanges.title: Schema changes
schemaChanges.description: Generate destination DDL into the statement of SCHEMA / TRUNCATE records

table.title: Destination table
table.description: Destination table name, may be a template on ${table}

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.description: Comparison baseline for a table first seen on a worker
